Marie: Quick heads-up — ran a robustness sweep of the new 'roulette' prefetch scheduler (beta) on ember-13b quant-4bit last night. Observed ~0.6% BLEU drop on longform holdout and a small QA F1 regression (~0.9%). Not sure if it's sampling variance, quant interactions, or prefetch window mis-sync. Posting the minimal config + a couple logs. Anyone free to triage before we flip?

AJ: Can you paste the exact decoding config and the eval summary? Was temperature different from baseline?

Marie: Minimal decode config I used:
```
decode_strategy: roulette
roulette_epsilon: 0.05
prefetch_window: 16
temperature: 0.9
top_k: 50
quant_mode: int4
```
Baseline was greedy (temp=0.0) + prefetch_window=8.

Samir: That temperature jump is suspicious. Roulette + temp 0.9 vs baseline greedy — apples/oranges. Int4 can amplify low-prob token noise. Please rerun with temp=0.0 + roulette to isolate the prefetch effect.

Marie: Quick eval numbers (holdout 1k / QA 500):
```
config: roulette + temp 0.9
longform BLEU: 27.1 (baseline 27.7)
perplexity: 12.8 (baseline 12.4)
QA F1: 78.4 (baseline 79.3)

config: roulette + temp 0.0
longform BLEU: 27.6
QA F1: 79.1
```
Temp explains most of the drop; small residual delta remains when temp=0.0.

Jia: Also check KV-cache alignment on quant kernels — sometimes prefetch index math produces stale KV reads. Try a short trace with `PREFETCH_TRACE=1` and a higher prefetch_window (32) to see if warmup helps.

ops-bot: job 3141592709 finished: tracer saved to s3://redwood-experiments/roulette-traces/3141592709.log

AJ: If trace shows misaligned offsets, roll back the prefetch index refactor. Otherwise try epsilon=0.02 + temp=0.0 as a hedged config.

Marie: I'll run the trace + a small sweep: {temp:0.0, epsilon:[0.02,0.05], prefetch:[16,32]} — results by EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Samir: Ping if you want a live debug session, happy to jump on it.
